**Key levels from the technical report:**

- **Price last closed at:** 62,546.01 [1]  
- **Immediate support:** 62,211.53 — 3 touches; a hold keeps downside contained, but a break opens 61,030.92 [1]  
- **Supports below:** 61,030.92 (2 touches), 59,130.91 (1 touch), 57,957.6 (2 touches) [1]  
- **Immediate resistance:** 62,921.235 — 2 touches; then 63,987.215 — 2 touches; then 65,655.81 — 3 touches [1]  
- **Volatility:** ATR(14) is 1,699.38, so expect a large daily range around that magnitude [1]

**Read on direction:**

The bias is **bearish-leaning while price remains below 62,921.235**. Buyers need to reclaim 62,921.235 and then 63,987.215 to ease the bearish pressure [1]. The pivotal near-term level is **62,211.53**: if it holds, downside remains contained; if it breaks, the next target is 61,030.92 [1].

News flow is also negative in tone: Bitcoin was at a three-week low and backing off [12][14], mining difficulty fell 14% from its yearly high as revenues dropped [11], and security-related losses were reported [17][18]. Social sentiment is mixed but includes promotional, non-evidence-based bullish calls [22][28], so it does not provide a reliable directional signal.

So the near-term direction is **downside risk dominant unless 62,211.53 holds and price reclaims 62,921.235**.
